verdicts.decision_note: Target-specific implementation claim: the first report that all measurements obtained so far were added to the preview drawing for dimensional confirmation.
The source presents a material unresolved choice about which overall or indicated dimension the manufacturing drawing should display.

The client changes the manufacturing drawing content by requiring the functional hole-to-hole dimension while retaining the overall length, preferably in brackets; no obsolete prior attribute requires removal.
The client resolves the pending drawing-dimension choice, allowing work on the dimensional documentation to resume.
